_comment: Presets of the CMS console page 'E-mail & SMS' (they only fill the form; nothing is saved until you press Save). Edit or add providers here - no code change needed. 'values' use the same keys as config/notify.conf.

email.label: Brevo (free: 300 e-mails/day)
email.help: Create a free Brevo account. Login = your Brevo e-mail. Password = the SMTP key (Brevo > SMTP & API > SMTP). From = a sender address you verified in Brevo.

email.label: Gmail (free)
email.help: Login = your Gmail address. Password = an App password (Google account > Security > 2-step verification > App passwords), not your normal password. From = the same Gmail address.

email.label: Other SMTP server
email.help: Enter the server name, port and login your mail provider gave you.

sms.label: Fast2SMS (India)
sms.help: Sign up at fast2sms.com (free credit, then a small recharge). API key = Fast2SMS panel > Dev API. Route 'q' (Quick SMS) needs no DLT registration; use 'dlt' once your template is approved.

sms.label: Twilio (worldwide; free trial = verified numbers only)
sms.help: Account SID and Auth token are on the Twilio console home page. 'From' = your Twilio phone number (+1...). A free trial can text only numbers you verified in the Twilio console.
